market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio faces a crowded 2028 field with no frontrunner status, historical headwinds for senators, and immense uncertainty four years out. 14.1% is far above a reasonable prior for any single candidate this early, making the Yes side overpriced.
evidence_points: Only three sitting senators have ever been elected president (Harding, Kennedy, Obama).
The 2028 Republican primary is expected to include high-profile candidates like DeSantis, Haley, and others, diluting Rubio's chances.
Rubio's 2016 presidential bid failed to win the nomination, and his national profile has not improved to frontrunner status.
